Commentary.Commentary: Right then, any total in excess of 150 is not easy to scale down. Pakistan though have the required batting firepower, they will have to approach the chase sensibly. The performance in the Powerplay for both teams will be critical as a flying start will throw the visitors out of the game very early while a few early wickets and Pakistan will feel the heat. Let's hope for an entertaining chase.

Pakistan will be pleased with their overall effort in the field, however, they were a bit sloppy in their ground fielding. Leaving alone Faheem Ashraf, every bowler left his impact and Mohammad Hasnain once more impressed with his pace and accuracy. Debutant Usman Qadir displayed his variations and had a decent outing.

It was an excellent bowling performance from Pakistan! They were a bit off-colour in the Powerplay but after that managed to get their act together. The bowling from them was brilliant in the middle overs and they dried the runs to create pressure. Barring Wesley Madhevere, there wasn't much in the Zimbabwean batting. The experienced players like Brendan Taylor and Sean Williams got starts but failed to make them count and that hurt Zimbabwe's cause. A word of praise for Wesley who once again showed his batting prowess and was very sensible with wickets falling around him.
26 runs in the last two overs and Zimbabwe found some late flourish to take their total over the 150-run mark. Credit to Elton Chigumbura for his handy cameo towards the end.

OUT! CAUGHT! The innings finishes with a wicket. 15 runs from the last over. Good length ball outside off, Chigumbura looks to go big on the off side but it takes the top edge and goes towards point. Hafeez runs back and manages to catch it on the second attempt. ZIMBABWE END ON 156 FOR 6.
SIX! Thrashed! What a hit! Brilliant from Elton Chigumbura. Short ball on middle, Chigumbura waits for it and then powers it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Just a single. Riaz runs in and then bowls a short one around off, Chigumbura pulls but does not time it well. It goes towards long off but before the fielder can cut it off, two taken. 150 up.
WIDE! Riaz switches to around the wicket and serves a delivery down the leg side, Chigumbura looks to flick but misses. Wide given.
Fullish on off, Madhevere thrashes it to long off but just a single.
Short ball on middle, Chigumbura pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! DRILLED! Short ball on off, Chigumbura hammers it down the ground for a boundary at long off. Perfect start to the last over for Zimbabwe.
FOUR! Good end to the over for Zimbabwe! 11 runs from it. Short of a length ball outside off, Madhevere punches it through the cover-point region for a boundary.
Slower ball on middle, Chigumbura looks to swing it away but gets it off the inside half and lobs towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball on middle, Chigumbura looks to pull but misses.
FOUR! Beautiful! Rauf knows that he has bowled a poor delivery and gets punished. Full outside off, Chigumbura drives it through extra cover for a boundary.
Nicely bowled from Rauf. Slower one on off, Madhevere looks to paddle but is early into the shot and it takes the bottom half of the bat and rolls to the side of the pitch.
Full on middle, Chigumbura heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Madhevere is down on the ground in some pain. The physio is out there to have a look at him. Let's hope that he is fine.
Short ball on middle, Madhevere looks to pull but it hits the body and rolls back to the keeper. Good over from Wahab at this stage.
A couple now! Short ball on middle, Madhevere pulls it to the deep square leg region for a couple.
Good length ball on off, Chigumbura guides it to the off side for a run.
Shortish on middle, Madhevere pulls it to long on for a single.
Fullish outside off, Chigumbura looks to drive but it takes the outside edge and goes towards third man for a single.
Length ball outside off, Madhevere guides it to third man for a single.
Wahab Riaz is back on. 2-0-16-1 are his figures so far.
Short ball on middle, Madhevere pulls but does not time it well. Luckily for him, it lands short of the fielder at deep mid-wicket. A single taken.
LEG BYE! Full delivery on the pads, Chigumbura looks to flick but misses and the ball goes off his pads towards short fine leg for a leg bye.
Length ball outside off, Elton punches it to cover.
Elton Chigumbura is the next man in. He has announced his retirement from all formats after this series. Would like to sign off in style, starting today.

OUT! TIMBER! Brilliant stuff from Rauf. He gets his second wicket. Burl was struggling to time the ball and he perishes. Rauf runs in and bowls a pacy length delivery on middle, Burl looks to hammer it to the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the stumps. Zimbabwe failing to find the final flourish.
Short ball on middle, Madhevere pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Full on off, Burl drives it to mid off and takes a single.
Haris Rauf is back on. 2-0-11-1 are his figures so far.

FOUR! No chance for the fielder in the deep. Brilliant batting from Madhevere. Back of a length ball outside off, Madhevere punches it through extra cover for a boundary. The fielder chases after it but in vain.
SWING AND A MISS! Fullish ball on the pads, Madhevere makes room and looks to heave it away but misses.
EDGY FOUR! Zimbabwe will take it anyhow they come. Full ball on off, Madhevere dances down the track and then looks to heave it away but gets an inside edge onto the fine leg region for a boundary.
PLAY AND A MISS! Fullish ball outside off, Madhevere goes on his knees and then looks to paddle but misses it completely.
Good length ball on off, Burl defends it to the cover region and takes a quick run.
FIFTY! First fifty for Wesley Madhevere in T20Is! He has looked settled at the crease and has played a wonderful knock for his side. Full ball on off, Wesley drives it to deep cover for a single.
Beaten! Speedy delivery, on a length and outside off, skidding away, Ryan pushes inside the line and misses. Good outing for Hasnain, finishes with 4-0-25-1!
Hangs on the back foot and punches it in the gap at covers for a run.

IN THE AIR... Drops in no man's land. Back of a length ball outside off, Burl advances down the track and throws his bat at it. It flies off the top edge and goes towards deep point. Hafeez runs behind from inside the ring and the sweeper cover fielder runs forward. No calling between them and the ball drops safely. A single added to the total.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, Burl covers the line and pushes it back.
A heavy delivery, fullish and on middle, Wesley pushes it down through mid on for a run.
Swing and a miss! Excellent pace from Hasnain as he serves a short and wide delivery outside off. Madhevere flashes and misses.
Wide! Wrong start! Hasnain slips a full ball down the leg side, Wesley tries to flick but misses.
Mohammad Hasnain returns into the attack.
Good length ball on off, Madhevere plays the off drive and keeps strike with a single. Moves to 47.
Angles in a fuller length ball on off, Wesley drives it back to the bowler.
A touch short and on middle, Burl helps it to short fine leg where the fielder makes a diving stop. The batsmen pinch a run.
Taps a length ball on the leg side and races away to the other end. Good smart cricket.
FOUR! Another excellent shot! Madhevere picks the short length ball early and pulls it powerfully past mid-wicket for a boundary. 100 up for Zimbabwe!
FOUR! Lovely shot! Madhevere uses his feet to a length ball outside off and smacks it through point for a boundary.
Flighted and full on middle, pushed back to the bowler to complete the over.
A googly around middle and leg, not picked. Wesley tries to cut but it takes the inside edge and goes past the stumps to short fine leg. They cross.

NOT OUT! The replays are not conclusive, feels the third umpire. Usman serves a flighted full ball around middle and leg, Wesley hops back to play a big shot but fails to make any contact. Rizwan collects the ball and breaks the stumps. He appeals vociferously and the square leg umpire signals for the third umpire. The replays come, Rashid Riaz takes his time, watches all the possible angles and then makes his decision in favour of the batsman. It was tough to find out whether the back foot was down and inside the line when the bails came off. Fair call.

An appeal for stumping taken upstairs. It looks close. Rizwan is confident. Let's see what happens. The umpire is taking a lot of time to give his decision. He gives it not out as there was no conclusive evidence to say that Madhevere's foot was outside the crease.
Flighted and full on middle, Burl works it across the line and the bowler moves to his left to stop the ball. He fails to do so though and they cross.
Knocks a full ball down to long on for a single.
A googly landing full around off, spinning away, Burl tries to heave but misses. It brushes the pads of Rizwan and rolls behind. They cross for a bye.
Usman Qadir is back into the attack. 2-0-21-1 are his figures so far.

Once again direct hit was the need of the hour! A sharp delivery by Hasnain, a bit short and around middle, Madhevere fails to pull and is hit on the thigh pad. Burl wants to steal a run and is midway down the track. The bowler collects the ball and had he scored the direct hit at the non-striker's end, it would have been curtains for Ryan.

Direct hit would have been close. A length ball around off, Ryan taps it down towards extra cover and is quick off the blocks. The fielder attacks the ball but misses his shy at the bowler's end. A risky run.
Stays on the back foot and plays it to the off side. Finds the fielder.
Back of a length ball outside off, Wesley reaches out and steers it through backward point for a run. Continues to look unperturbed, Madhevere.
This time Burl plays inside the line and manages to send it down towards third man for a run.
Beaten! Good delivery. A length ball around off, skidding away after landing, Burl hangs his bat out in defense and gets beaten.
Mohammad Hasnain back on.
Uses the angle of the bowler and eases it down to third man for a run. Eventful over.
Ryan Burl makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! Riaz bounces back after going for 10 runs in the over. He sends back Sikandar with a snorter of a delivery. A well-directed short ball, around middle and leg, Raza is taken by surprise as it shoots up off the surface. Tries to fend it off but ends up getting it off the shoulder of his bat. Rizwan runs forward swiftly and takes the catch safely.

FOUR! Bisects the fielders in the deep. Back of a length ball on middle, Raza gets on top of the bounce and glances it through square leg. Two fielders converge in the deep but the ball finds the gap to meet the fence.
Outside off, played down to third man for a run.
FOUR! Wesley is a class batsman! Showed it in the ODIs and showing it again. Riaz pitches it up this time and Madhevere drives it elegantly through extra cover.
Babar Azam is going off the field to get some treatment.
Babar Azam seems to have hurt himself after stopping that ball and is getting it checked by the physio.

Smashed and a good stop by the skipper. Width on offer outside off, short and wide, Raza slaps it to covers where Babar goes down quickly and stops it with his left hand. That's hit ferociously. A half-stop, so a run is taken. Azam seems to have hurt himself.

Wahab Riaz is back on. Wait on, there is a slight halt in play. The ball is lying unattended on the ground. Has someone used saliva on the ball? Yeah, we have the confirmation now. The ball is now being sanitized and we are good to go again. It will take time to get used to these new rules. The first official warning is also given for using the saliva on the ball.
FOUR! Nicely cut away! Flatter and outside off, Madhevere cuts it through the cover-point region for a boundary. Zimbabwe are 77 for 3 at the end of 10.
Flatter ball outside off, Raza punches it through the covers for a single.
Wide of the bowler. Shortish on off, Madhevere looks to pull but it takes the bottom half of the bat and it goes past the bowler for a single.
Loopy ball on middle, Raza works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Sikandar Raza comes out to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! Usman Qadir gets his first wicket in international cricket. What a proud moment for the young man. He was expensive in his first over but has come back well in the second. Brilliant delivery. Qadir tosses this one on off, Williams dances down the track and then looks to go big over the bowler's head but he misses and the ball goes onto hit the off stump. Williams wastes a good start.
Tossed up on middle, Madhevere heaves it to long on for a single.
Full on middle, Williams works it to the leg side. 7 from the over!
Floated on off, Madhevere drives it to long off for a run.
Flatter ball on middle, Williams works it down to long on for a single.
An appeal for LBW turned down! Hafeez bowls a full one on the pads, Williams goes on his knees to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. Hafeez appeals but the umpire is not interested.
On off, Madhevere plays it to the off side for a single.
FOUR! Nicely reverse swept. Zimbabwe are on the charge. Hafeez starts with a floated ball on middle, Madhevere reverse sweeps it through the point region for a boundary.
Mohammad Hafeez is into the attack.
FOUR! Brilliantly played! Perfect placement. Flighted outside off, Williams drives it through extra cover and picks up a boundary. Good over for Zimbabwe. 13 from it!
On off, driven to long off for a single.

SIX! What a shot from Madhevere. First maximum of the game. Short on middle, Madhevere camps on his back foot and then pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. The keeper is quite vocal, encouraging the debutant. Rizwan feels it was a good delivery and the batsman played a good shot. Also, the wind took it over the fence. Hmm... A half-tracker ain't that good a delivery though!

NOT OUT! Madhevere is well in. Floated on middle, Williams sweeps it to short fine leg and takes off for a single. The fielder has a shy at the keeper's end and hits. Rizwan is confident and appeals. The third umpire is called for but the replays show that Wesley Madhevere is comfortably in.
An appeal for a run out at the striker's end is taken upstairs. Direct hits are often close but on this occasion, the replay finds that Wesley is home safely.
Short ball on middle, Wesley pulls it to deep mid-wicket and takes a run. 50 up for Zimbabwe.
Qadir starts with a floated ball on middle, Madhevere defends it back to the bowler.
Usman Qadir is into the attack. Can he make an impact on his debut?
PLAY AND A MISS! Short ball outside off, Williams rocks on his back foot and then looks to pull but misses it.
Good length ball on middle, Wesley pushes it down to long on for another run.
On a length outside off, Williams punches it to deep cover and gives Madhevere the strike.
Full outside off, Williams drives but finds the cover fielder.
Length ball on off, Madhevere pushes it to the deep cover region for a single.

FOUR! That was not timed so well but it still has enough to go to the fence. Poor fielding though from Rauf. Full outside off, Madhevere lifts it over extra cover. Rauf chases after it and slides but fails to stop as the ball rolls to the fence.
Faheem Ashraf comes back on. 1-0-7-0 are his figures so far.
Full ball on middle, Williams drives but it goes straight back to the bowler. Zimbabwe are 42 for 2 at the end of the Powerplay.
Length ball on middle, Wesley nudges it to deep square leg and crosses over for a run.
Good length ball outside off, Williams pushes it to the cover region for a single.
An appeal for LBW turned down! On a length and on the pads, Williams looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire.
Back of a length ball on middle, Williams flicks it to the deep square leg region for a couple.
EDGY! Good length ball outside off, Madhevere looks to drive but it takes the inside edge and goes towards square leg. A single taken.
Wahab Riaz comes into the attack.
Uses the angle of the bowler and knocks a fuller length ball wide of mid on for a run. End of a successful over for Rauf.
Short delivery on off, Williams pulls it behind square leg and takes a single.
Pacy delivery, short and around middle and leg, Wesley turns to pull but fails to middle his shot. It brushes his body and drops near the surface. Sean calls him through for a quick leg bye.
Full in length and outside off, driven confidently off the front foot to mid off.
Pitches it up and outside off, Madhevere drives it through the line but finds backward point.
Wesley Madhevere is the next man out in the middle.

OUT! Taylor holes out! Big blow to Zimbabwe! Rauf angles in a fuller length ball around off, Brendan uses his wrists for the flick shot but fails to keep it down, rather he wanted to play it aerial but fails to get enough power or timing behind his shot. A simple catch for Haider Ali at deep square leg. A disappointed Taylor returns after getting a start.
Haris Rauf is back into the attack.

A mishit on this occasion. Shortish and on off, Taylor tries to pull it across the line but it takes the bottom half of his blade and rolls in front of mid on. Enough time to pick a single. Good going for Zimbabwe!
A touch short and on off, Brendan once again plays it down from the crease to the off side.
On a length around off, defended from the back foot to covers.

FOUR! Brings out innovation and gets a boundary. Again a misfield. Not looking switched on, Pakistan. A length ball around off, Taylor walks across and paddles it towards short fine leg. The fielder there is lazy in getting down and then tries to chase it. His attempt to pull it back flops and the onfield umpire confirms upstairs before signalling the boundary.
Fullish and on the pads, it's clipped with lovely timing to deep square leg for a run.

Some movement on offer. A length ball landing outside off and nipping back in a shade. Taylor leans forward to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It deflects to covers and they steal a run.
Faheem Ashraf is into the attack.
Good length ball on off, Williams defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Bang! Hasnain overpitches it outside off, offers width too, Sean Williams exercises his arms and bludgeons it through covers for a cracking boundary.
Stays on the back foot and defends a length ball on the off side.

FOUR! Poor fielding! Good length ball around middle and leg, Williams uses his wrists and works it towards short fine leg where Faheem dives but fails to stop the ball. That was a lazy bit of effort. It speeds past him and meets the fence.
Turns a length ball in the gap on the leg side and scampers across to the other end.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Good timing from Taylor. Limited footwork but he strokes his shot through the cover region with sweet timing and finds the gap as well.
FOUR! Shot! Back of a length delivery outside off, plenty of width on offer, Williams rocks back, reaches out for it and smashes it in front of square on the off side for a boundary. 9 from the over!
A touch short and on off, Brendan goes on his toes and taps it down towards cover-point for one.
Good length ball around off, Williams taps it down towards backward point for a run.

PITCHING OUTSIDE LEG! No need to look any further. Rauf spears in a full ball around leg, Williams tries to flick but misses. He is thudded on the front pad, they appeal but the umpire remains unmoved. The bowler consults the keeper and then the skipper takes the DRS. The replays roll in, Ultra Edge finds no wood but the Ball Tracker confirms that the pitching is an issue. Both sides have lost one referral each now.
Flashes and misses! Beaten for pace. A length ball angling away from the southpaw, Williams throws his bat at it and is beaten on the inside edge.
Pakistan take a review for LBW! It looks like it is going down the leg side. The Ball Tracker rolls in and it shows that it is pitching outside leg.
Lovely shot! Fuller length ball around off, Taylor leans forward and across before working it wide of mid on. The fielder chases it down and they take three runs.
The birthday boy, Haris Rauf will bowl from the other end.
Stifled appeal for an lbw, not given. Williams fails to work a length ball on the leg side. He wears it on his pads, the appeal is made but maybe it pitched outside leg.
Sean Williams is the next man out in the middle.

OUT! Hitting the stumps! The skipper bags a duck. Hasnain with early success yet again. He angles in a length ball around off and gets it to skid into the batsman. Chibhabha is stuck inside the crease as he tries to work it around on the leg side. Gets beaten by pace and is struck on the front pad. The appeal is made and the finger goes up. Chamu refers the decision after having a word with his partner. The replays roll in and it finds everything in line. Three reds and the skipper is on his bike. Early exit for him.
Chibhaba has been given out LBW! He consults with his partner and takes the review. There is no bat on it but the Ball Tarcker shows that all reds, so Chibhabha has to go.
Good length ball on middle, Chibhabha defends it out.
Length ball on off, Taylor blocks it to cover and takes a quick single.
PLAY AND A MISS! That ball kept a little low. Good length ball outside off, Taylor looks to cut but it keeps a little low and that causes Taylor to miss.

EDGY FOUR! Streaky way to get off the mark! Hasnain begins with a shortish delivery around off, Taylor is stuck on the crease as he pushes inside the line tentatively. Gets an inside edge, it beats the stumps and races away to the fine leg fence.
We are all set to begin! The Pakistan players stride out to the middle, followed by Chamu Chibhabha and Brendan Taylor. Mohammad Hasnain will start with the ball.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Chamu Chibhabha (C), Ryan Burl, Brendan Taylor (WK), Sean Williams, Wesley Madhevere, Sikandar Raza, Tendai Chisoro, Tendai Chatara, Elton Chigumbura, Blessing Muzarabani, Richard Ngarava.

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Fakhar Zaman, Babar Azam (C), Haider Ali, Mohammad Hafeez, Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Khushdil Shah, Faheem Ashraf, Wahab Riaz, Usman Qadir (ON DEBUT), Haris Rauf, Mohammad Hasnain.
Toss - Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of Zimbabwe. They have elected to bat first.

As far as Zimbabwe are concerned, they are a team happy to be playing international cricket more than anything. Lack of opportunities and then their internal board matters have often hampered their progress at the bigger stage but now they are appearing to settle down. Still, early days in the captaincy for Chamu Chibhabha who has been appointed at the moment on an interim basis and he would like to register some success in this series to prove himself. He has a fairly inexperienced squad at his disposal but there are players of the calibre of Sean Williams, Sikandar Raza, Brendan Taylor, Craig Ervine who have been around for long and would be expected to deliver the goods. Let's see how they combine and take Zimbabwe forward.

We still have some time left for the toss, let's have a look at both the squads. Needless to say, Pakistan are a formidable unit with a nice blend of youth and experience. They have stroke-makers, power-hitters, utility all-rounders, quality spinners and then hostile pacemen in their ranks. Having said that, in this format, how you perform and execute your skills on that day matters the most. Anyway, the hosts would be hurt after an embarrassing loss in the last ODI and would be coming out with more intensity.

Warm welcome one and all for the first T20I of the series between Pakistan and Zimbabwe. The last ODI is still fresh in our memories and if the visitors manage to show the same fight and decisiveness, we're in for a cracking game. It's going to be the first T20I match in Rawalpindi and given that it's an afternoon start, let's hope for a fair battle between bat and ball.
